summary: Add one guided Settings checkup with a single privacy-safe report for Emoji layout, suggestions, toolbar, panel glass and Parakeet A/B checks.

changes.title: Reuse unchanged panel glass recordings
changes.detail: The Emoji, Clipboard, and Toolbar frosted overlays now retain their GPU RenderNode recording between unchanged frames and refresh it on scrolling, layout, sizing, and explicit surface updates. This removes repeated source-tree recording while preserving the same live in-panel content and blur.

changes.title: Remove the stale Search row above Emoji Browse
changes.detail: Emoji Search results and the no-results panel now remain hidden whenever Search mode is off, including when an asynchronous Search refresh arrives after leaving Search. This prevents the fixed 56dp row from stealing height above the category tabs and emoji grid. The content-free geometry report now includes visibility states for these Search-only rows.

changes.title: Compare Parakeet models on the same Voice Lab recording
changes.detail: The Settings checkup guides the manual device checks and copies one plain-text report containing device/layout data, selected outcomes and numeric-only voice timing, WER and memory metrics. Typed test text, clipboard contents, reference phrases, transcripts, audio, screenshots and free-form notes are excluded. This update does not bundle model weights; verified models already installed in private app storage remain available. The release workflow retains an explicit bundle_ultra_model option for a future update only when requested.

changes.title: Copy all manual check results in one report
changes.detail: Settings now has one guided device checkup for Emoji top spacing, smart Emoji suggestions and motion, toolbar layout, progressive panel blur, and one-take Parakeet A/B behavior. Geometry is included only when newly recorded during this checkup. The Voice Lab's separate transcript-copy control is hidden when opened from this flow.
